definitions.explanation: Bright, colorful, or attention-grabbing in appearance; standing out through boldness.
Grand or excessive in spending or lifestyle.

examples.japanese: {派手|はで}な{服|ふく}を{着|き}ている。
{彼|かれ}は{派手|はで}な{生活|せいかつ}を{送|おく}っている。
{派手|はで}に{転|ころ}んでしまった。
examples.notes: 派手に = in a flashy/spectacular way

notes:
USAGE: {派手|はで} describes things that stand out visually or attract attention. It can be neutral or slightly negative depending on context.

FORMS:
・{派手|はで}な + noun (flashy ~)
・{派手|はで}に + verb (flashily, spectacularly)

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{派手|はで}な{色|いろ} (bright/flashy colors)
・{派手|はで}な{服|ふく} (flashy clothes)
・{派手|はで}に{使|つか}う (to spend lavishly)
・{派手|はで}に{転|ころ}ぶ (to fall spectacularly)

ANTONYM:
・{地味|じみ} (plain, subdued, quiet)

NUANCE: {派手|はで} can be positive (eye-catching, impressive) or negative (gaudy, tasteless) depending on context and speaker's tone.
